arguments.message: Timestamps are stored in UTC and shown in the timezone set for the account. If a user’s personal timezone isn’t set, Meridian falls back to the workspace default, which can make the same record appear at different times for people in other zones. To fix this, have your teammate open **Settings → Profile** in their personal account and set their own timezone. That personal setting overrides the workspace default for them only, so the timestamps will display correctly for their location without affecting anyone else.
